intent: Labelled filters above a list, submitted together with a Find button: a Toolbar rendered as a named form (as="form", so Find and Enter submit — wire onSubmit), aligned to the start so every control sits on one line under its visible Field label and Find drops onto that line. A field's description or error line hangs below its control and moves nothing else; the error line is the Field's own, with its usual aria-describedby wiring — set error on the Field, not beside the row. Every label in the row must be one line: a label that wraps pushes its control off the shared line. Add IconSearch before the Find label. For filters that apply as they change, named without a visible label, use filter-toolbar instead; never name a control by its placeholder alone
